contents.text: In Netflix's statement of comprehensive income, how much in cash flow hedge gains was reclassified in 2024?

$96,795 thousand was reclassified from AOCI into the Consolidated Statements of Operations in 2024, as stated in the excerpt from NFLX-10K-2025.html, section PART IV > Financial Statements > Stockholders' Equity (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Stockholders' Equity).
